# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## Product Name

**Paper Composer – Handwritten to Composed Exam Paper**

---

## 1. Product Overview

Paper Composer is a web-based application that allows users to upload handwritten exam papers or notes (images or scanned files). The system converts handwritten content into a clean, professionally formatted **A4 composed paper** suitable for school, college, and university use.

The app supports **all subjects**, maintains proper headings, questions, answers, numbering, and formatting, and allows users to **download the final output in MS Word (.docx) and PDF formats**.

The product is designed to be built using **Vibe Coding (AI-assisted development)** for rapid development and scalability.

---

## 2. Problem Statement

Students and teachers often face challenges such as:

* Poor handwriting affecting readability
* Time-consuming manual typing of handwritten papers
* Formatting issues for exams and assignments
* Lack of a simple tool to convert handwritten papers into clean, printable documents

Paper Composer solves this by automating handwriting recognition, correction, formatting, and document generation.

---

## 3. Target Users

* School Students (Primary, Secondary)
* College & University Students
* Teachers & Tutors
* Coaching Centers
* Private Exam Candidates

---

## 4. Core Features

### 4.1 Handwritten Paper Upload

* Upload formats:

  * JPG / PNG
  * PDF (scanned images)
* Multiple pages support
* Mobile & desktop friendly upload

---

### 4.2 Handwriting Recognition (OCR + AI)

* Convert handwritten text into editable digital text
* Support for:

  * English (Phase 1)
  * Urdu / Roman Urdu (Phase 2 – optional)
* Auto spell correction
* Smart word guessing for unclear handwriting

---

### 4.3 Subject-Aware Formatting

* Works for **all subjects** (Math, Science, English, Islamiat, SST, Computer, etc.)
* Automatic detection of:

  * Questions & Answers
  * Headings
  * Paragraphs
  * Bullet points & numbering
* Mathematical equations formatted cleanly

---

### 4.4 A4 Composed Paper Output

* Standard A4 size
* Clean margins
* Proper line spacing
* Exam-style layout
* Professional font (Times New Roman / Calibri)

---

### 4.5 Editing Interface

* Simple text editor before final download
* Users can:

  * Correct words
  * Edit formatting
  * Adjust spacing
* Live preview of A4 layout

---

### 4.6 Download Options

* Download as:

  * MS Word (.docx)
  * PDF (.pdf)
* Watermark-free (for premium users)

---

## 5. User Flow

1. User opens web app
2. Uploads handwritten paper (image/PDF)
3. Clicks **Compose Paper**
4. AI processes handwriting → text
5. System formats content into A4 exam style
6. User previews & edits (optional)
7. Downloads paper in Word or PDF

---

## 6. Functional Requirements

### Upload Module

* File size limit (e.g., 10–20 MB)
* Multiple page handling

### AI Processing

* OCR + AI text refinement
* Paragraph & question detection

### Formatting Engine

* A4 layout enforcement
* Subject-neutral formatting rules

### Export Engine

* Word document generator
* PDF generator

---

## 7. Non-Functional Requirements

* Fast processing (under 30–60 seconds)
* Secure file handling (auto-delete after processing)
* Responsive design
* Scalable backend

---

## 8. Tech Stack (Suggested)

### Frontend

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* React / Next.js
* Tailwind CSS

### Backend

* Node.js / Python (FastAPI)
* AI OCR APIs (Google Vision / Azure / OpenAI Vision)

### Document Generation

* docx library for Word export
* PDF generation library

### Hosting

* Cloud-based (Vercel / AWS / Firebase)

---

## 9. Monetization (Optional)

* Free version:

  * Limited pages
  * Watermark
* Paid version:

  * Unlimited papers
  * No watermark
  * Faster processing

---

## 10. Future Enhancements

* Urdu handwriting support
* Math equation recognition
* Student name, roll no, subject auto-fill
* Teacher dashboard
* Mobile app version

---

## 11. Success Metrics

* Number of papers composed per day
* Conversion rate to downloads
* User retention
* Accuracy of handwriting recognition

---

## 12. Conclusion

Paper Composer is a powerful, AI-driven solution that transforms handwritten exam papers into professional, print-ready documents. It saves time, improves presentation quality, and works across all subjects with minimal user effort.

This PRD is ready to be used for **Vibe Coding development** and AI-assisted implementation.
